consequence.statement: The four citadel_server certificate-expiry metrics now update when new certificates are loaded. Before this fix they could keep stale values, so dashboards or alerts built on them may show different values.
consequence.remediation: Check any alerts or dashboards that use these metrics.

assertion.statement: The citadel_server_root_cert_expiry_timestamp, citadel_server_root_cert_expiry_seconds, citadel_server_cert_chain_expiry_timestamp and citadel_server_cert_chain_expiry_seconds metrics now update when new certificates are loaded.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The evidence names no setting, flag or version condition. It does not say which environments are affected beyond the metrics now updating when certificates are reloaded.
